overview_description.description: Tacto leverages AI to transform procurement, unlocking savings and efficiency gains for industrial companies. By analyzing millions of data points, Tacto uncovers hidden savings and drives measurable efficiency gains across the entire supplier base. With AI at its core, Tacto continuously identifies price deviations, inefficiencies, and consolidation opportunities turning procurement from a reactive cost center into a proactive value driver for the business.

product.name: Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) System
product.description: A digital platform for managing supplier data, evaluations, and compliance to optimize procurement processes for mid-sized industrial companies.

product.name: Procurement Analytics Module
product.description: A tool that analyzes purchasing data to identify cost-saving opportunities and optimize procurement strategies for industrial buyers.

product.name: Digital Audit Planning Tool
product.description: A software solution for planning, managing, and documenting supplier audits to ensure quality and compliance in procurement.

product.name: E-Procurement and Demand Management System
product.description: A digital platform for capturing and managing internal material and service demands to streamline purchasing workflows.

product.name: Digital Contract Management System
product.description: A platform for creating, managing, and automating procurement contracts and business terms to ensure compliance and reduce risks.
